description: This file defines an Android custom View class called OverlayView which allows other classes to register draw callbacks that are invoked during the view's draw process.

classes.name: OverlayView
classes.description: A custom Android View that manages a list of callback interfaces to perform actions during drawing.

classes.name: OverlayView.DrawCallback
classes.description: An interface defining a callback method to be invoked when the view is drawn.

methods.name: OverlayView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OverlayView with context and attribute set.

methods.name: addCallback
methods.description: Method to add a DrawCallback to the list of callbacks.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Overridden method that calls each registered callback during the drawing process.
